scenes.text: Choose exact start and end times in your browser's time zone. Shared links keep the same window.
Register your device, then run one installation command. Enter your attribution ID and token privately in the terminal.
Drag the usage chart to narrow the period. User detail stays open, and the top twenty tasks update.
Follow agent lanes, model calls, and cache tokens. Matching names remain separate lanes, with their own costs.
Inspect connected MCP servers, loaded plugins, and the first call's context. Missing telemetry remains unavailable.
Dashed cost lines connect observations across unknown intervals. They are guides, not measured values. Explore the complete documentation.
